description: Check whether a dashboard can be owned by the current user.

examples.user_query: Can I take ownership of the dashboard with ID '12345abcde'?
examples.notes: This checks if the current user can own the dashboard with the specified ID. Useful for determining ownership eligibility before attempting to transfer ownership.

examples.user_query: Am I allowed to own the dashboard with ID '67890fghij'?
examples.notes: This verifies whether the user has the necessary permissions to own the dashboard. Use this to validate ownership rules for a specific dashboard.

examples.user_query: Is it possible for me to own the dashboard 'abcdef12345'?
examples.notes: This call determines if the current user can take ownership of the dashboard identified by the given ID. Ideal for scenarios where ownership transfer is being considered.

description: Export a dashboard definition using the Sisense admin export endpoint.

examples.user_query: How can I export the definition of the Sales Performance dashboard?
examples.notes: This call retrieves the full definition of the 'Sales Performance' dashboard, including its widgets, layout, and filters.

examples.user_query: I need to back up the Marketing Overview dashboard. How do I export it?
examples.notes: This call exports the 'Marketing Overview' dashboard definition, which can be saved for backup or migration purposes.

examples.user_query: Can I get the JSON definition for the Customer Insights dashboard?
examples.notes: This call fetches the JSON definition of the 'Customer Insights' dashboard, useful for reviewing or modifying its structure programmatically.

description: Retrieves all dashboards from the Sisense server.

examples.user_query: How can I get a list of all dashboards available on the Sisense server?
examples.notes: This call retrieves all dashboards currently available on the Sisense server. Use it to fetch an overview of all dashboards for further analysis or management.

examples.user_query: I need to see all dashboards to check which ones are active.
examples.notes: This call provides a complete list of dashboards. It is useful for auditing or reviewing the available dashboards on the server.

examples.user_query: Can I get all dashboards to display them in a custom application?
examples.notes: This call retrieves all dashboards, which can then be integrated into a custom application for display or further processing.

description: Retrieves a specific dashboard by its ID.

dashboard_id.description: The ID of the dashboard to retrieve.

examples.user_query: Can you fetch the dashboard with ID 'sales_dashboard_2023'?
examples.notes: This retrieves the details of the dashboard with the ID 'sales_dashboard_2023'. Use this to access specific dashboard information for reporting or analysis.

examples.user_query: I need to get the dashboard details for the marketing team. The ID is 'marketing_q4_dashboard'.
examples.notes: This call fetches the dashboard with the ID 'marketing_q4_dashboard'. Ideal for retrieving dashboards used by specific teams or departments.

examples.user_query: What are the details of the dashboard with ID 'finance_overview_001'?
examples.notes: This retrieves the dashboard identified by 'finance_overview_001'. Useful for accessing financial overview dashboards for review or updates.

description: Retrieves a specific dashboard by its name.

dashboard_name.description: The name of the dashboard to retrieve.

examples.user_query: Can you fetch the dashboard named 'Sales Overview'?
examples.notes: This retrieves the 'Sales Overview' dashboard, which might contain key metrics and visualizations for sales performance.

examples.user_query: I need to find the dashboard called 'Marketing Performance'.
examples.notes: This call fetches the 'Marketing Performance' dashboard, which could include analytics related to marketing campaigns and performance metrics.

examples.user_query: Get the dashboard titled 'Executive Summary'.
examples.notes: This retrieves the 'Executive Summary' dashboard, often used for high-level reporting and insights for executives.

description: Retrieve widget definitions from an admin export of the dashboard.

examples.user_query: What widgets are included in the dashboard titled 'Sales Overview'?
examples.notes: This retrieves all widget definitions from the 'Sales Overview' dashboard using its title as a reference.

examples.user_query: Can you list the widgets for the dashboard with ID '63f2a1b4c9e3470012345678'?
examples.notes: This fetches widget definitions from the dashboard identified by its unique 24-character ID.

examples.user_query: I need to check the widgets in the dashboard named 'Marketing Performance'.
examples.notes: Use this to retrieve widget details from the 'Marketing Performance' dashboard by specifying its title.

description: Retrieve dashboards visible to the authenticated user.

fields.description: Subset of fields to include in the response (for example ``["oid", "title", "owner"]``). When omitted, all fields are returned.

examples.user_query: Show me the dashboards I own with their titles and IDs.
examples.notes: This call retrieves only the 'oid' and 'title' fields for dashboards visible to the authenticated user. Use this to quickly fetch basic identifiers for dashboards.

examples.user_query: Get all details for dashboards shared with me.
examples.notes: When the 'fields' parameter is omitted or an empty array is provided, all available fields for the dashboards are returned. Use this to access comprehensive dashboard details.

examples.user_query: I need the titles and owners of dashboards I can access.
examples.notes: This call retrieves only the 'title' and 'owner' fields for dashboards visible to the authenticated user. Use this to focus on ownership and naming details.

description: Move a dashboard into a folder.

examples.user_query: How can I move the sales dashboard to the marketing folder?
examples.notes: This moves the dashboard with ID 'dashboard_12345' into the folder with ID 'folder_67890', which is the marketing folder.

examples.user_query: I need to organize my dashboards. Can you help me move the 'Finance Overview' dashboard to the 'Q4 Reports' folder?
examples.notes: This operation relocates the 'Finance Overview' dashboard to the 'Q4 Reports' folder for better organization.

examples.user_query: Can I move the 'Customer Insights' dashboard to the 'Archived Dashboards' folder?
examples.notes: This moves the 'Customer Insights' dashboard into the 'Archived Dashboards' folder, typically used for storing older dashboards.

examples.user_query: Publish the sales dashboard to make the latest updates available.
examples.notes: This call republishes the 'sales_dashboard_123' dashboard with admin access enabled. Use this when you want to publish updates without forcing changes.

examples.user_query: Force publish the marketing dashboard after script updates.
examples.notes: This call republishes the 'marketing_dashboard_456' dashboard with admin access and forces the update. Use this when changes need to be applied after script modifications.

examples.user_query: Republish the finance dashboard without admin access.
examples.notes: This call republishes the 'finance_dashboard_789' dashboard without admin access. Use this when the caller has sufficient permissions and no forced updates are required.

dashboard_id.description: The ``oid`` of the dashboard to rename.

examples.user_query: How can I rename the Sales Overview dashboard to Q1 Sales Overview?
examples.notes: This call renames the dashboard with ID '5f7d3a2b6e7a4c001f3e8b9c' to 'Q1 Sales Overview'. Use this when you want to update the title of an existing dashboard.

examples.user_query: I need to change the title of the Marketing Performance dashboard to Monthly Marketing Metrics.
examples.notes: This call updates the title of the dashboard with ID '63a9f0ea7b8e4d0021c4d5a1' to 'Monthly Marketing Metrics'. Useful for keeping dashboard titles aligned with reporting periods.

examples.user_query: Can I rename the Customer Insights dashboard to Customer Analytics?
examples.notes: This call changes the name of the dashboard with ID '7e2b4c9f8a6d4f0032b7e1d5' to 'Customer Analytics'. Ideal for rebranding or clarifying the purpose of a dashboard.

description: Resolve a dashboard reference (ID or name) to a concrete dashboard ID and title.

dashboard_ref.description: Dashboard reference to resolve. This can be either an ID or a name.

examples.user_query: What is the ID and title of the dashboard named 'Sales Overview'?
examples.notes: This resolves the dashboard reference 'Sales Overview' to its corresponding ID and title. Use this when you know the dashboard name but need its ID.

examples.user_query: Can you find the dashboard with the ID '5f7d3a2b4e8b9c0012345678'?
examples.notes: This resolves the dashboard reference '5f7d3a2b4e8b9c0012345678' to its corresponding ID and title. Use this when you already have the dashboard ID but want to confirm its existence and retrieve its title.

examples.user_query: I need the details of a dashboard called 'Monthly Performance Report'.
examples.notes: This resolves the dashboard reference 'Monthly Performance Report' to its corresponding ID and title. Use this when you know the dashboard name but need its details.
